description: The countries the Uppsala Conflict Data Program codes, with their Gleditsch-Ward country codes, region, years covered and the latest year's total deaths from organized violence. Use it to resolve a country name or code before calling other ucdp tools, or to rank countries by conflict deaths. Example: ucdp_countries({ query: "congo" })

min_deaths.description: Only countries with at least this many organized-violence deaths (best estimate) in the latest year

query.description: Substring of the country name; omit for the full list

region.description: Filter by UCDP region: Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Middle East

name: ucdp_countries
title: Ucdp Countries
